item.description: What you need to know about back-to-school season 2026. Plus, court filing challenges use of Florida's 'Halo Law' in woman's arrest.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County Public Schools has several construction projects underway
item.description: Construction is underway on a new middle school in Wimauma as Hillsborough County works to keep pace with a rapidly growing student population in the southeastern part of the county.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Polk County Schools charges $400 fee for private school students joining district sports teams
item.description: Polk County Schools approved a $400 fee for private school students joining district sports teams under a new Florida state law.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Back-to-school tech shopping: Experts say think single-use devices over all-in-one gadgets
item.description: As back-to-school shopping ramps up, tech experts are urging parents to be just as thoughtful about selecting electronic devices as they are about backpacks and school supplies.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Local schools looking to hire bus drivers ahead of back-to-school season
item.description: Polk County Public Schools is urgently seeking bus drivers before the new school year begins, with more than 60 full-time positions still unfilled.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] What Manatee County parents need to know about school bus changes this year
item.description: Manatee County School District will start the year short 12 bus drivers. All routes will be covered, but some students may experience longer rides or adjusted pickup times until positions are filled.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco County Superintendent discusses 'A' district grade, upcoming school year
item.description: One of the most dramatic turnarounds in the entire state is in Pasco County, as the district earned its first “A” grade since 2009.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two new elementary schools are opening in Manatee County this school year
item.description: Manatee County Schools return to the classroom on Aug. 10. This year, two new elementary schools will be open: Veterans Elementary and Rye Ranch Elementary.
